new_rules_labelled_post_hoc.R1_code_verification_classes: POST HOC (decided after the Cook 3D check, pending Professor Rabczuk): a manufactured-solution check is PASS (rates within 0.2 of theory, unchanged), INCONCLUSIVE (errors fall at every level but the rates are not within tolerance at the finest affordable levels) or FAIL (an error does not fall). Before, everything not PASS was FAIL.
new_rules_labelled_post_hoc.R2_reference_domain: POST HOC, pending Professor Rabczuk: when the production-domain check is INCONCLUSIVE, the same check is run on a reference domain (the bounding rectangle of the section, same thickness, the same boundary-condition types, a circular hole if the problem has one). If that PASSES, the loop continues and every result of the run is labelled 'code verified on the reference domain'. A FAIL still stops the loop.
